items.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs log $2.7 billion in September inflows as institutional demand holds
items.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs recorded $2.65 billion in net inflows in September, their second-largest monthly inflow since October 2025.

items.title: South Korea advances tokenized securities rules ahead of 2027 rollout
items.summary: South Korea’s financial regulator proposed detailed rules for tokenized securities, including capital requirements, OTC trading licenses and retail investment limits.

items.title: Kinetiq Ends kPoints With Paid Claim as KNTQ Drops 23%
items.summary: Points holders have 10 days to buy from a 50 million-token allocation at $0.26 per KNTQ, potentially generating $13 million in gross proceeds.

items.title: Zcash Drops 21% From Recent High—Here’s Why the Rally May Not Be Over
items.summary: ZEC is 21% off its $1,698 peak after ETF outflows and a suspected North Korean heist routed money through its shielded pool.
